title: Tenant Catalog Governance, Entra Security Groups & Inventory Audits
summary: Manage agent lifecycle in Microsoft 365 Admin Center, remediate orphaned owners, and enforce Entra security group scoping.

intro.what: Operational governance controls for M365 Global Admins, AI Admins, and Power Platform Admins.
intro.features: Covers Integrated Apps catalog publishing, blocking broad Everyone-in-Org sharing on unreviewed agents, and auditing Agent-Inventory-Audit.csv.

sections.title: Auditing Tenant Agent Posture
paragraphs: M365 Engineers should periodically review active agents across four hygiene criteria: (1) Knowledge URLs point to shared SharePoint libraries rather than personal OneDrive, (2) WebSearch is disabled on policy/compliance agents, (3) Sharing scope uses Entra security groups rather than tenant-wide Everyone unless approved in the Admin Catalog, and (4) Every production agent has at least two active owners.
sources: Microsoft · Manage Copilot agents in Microsoft 365 admin center

title: Enterprise Rollout, Telemetry & Regression Evaluation Playbook
summary: A four-stage engineering rollout pipeline: Golden Prompt Eval -> Security & DLP Review -> Phased Group Rollout -> Purview & Telemetry Monitoring.

intro.what: Standard operating procedure for taking business-unit agents from prototype to governed production.
intro.features: Combines golden regression test suites, Purview audit verification, and Copilot Studio analytics.
intro.exchange: Verify zero unintended external data egress prior to catalog publication.
intro.m365: Track user satisfaction, fallback/unanswered rate, and autonomous trigger run history.
intro.developer: Maintain a versioned JSON/CSV golden test suite in Git alongside declarative manifests.
sources: Microsoft · Analytics and telemetry in Copilot Studio

sections.title: Four-Gate Engineering Release Pipeline
paragraphs: Gate 1 — Golden Prompt Evaluation: Run positive, boundary, and adversarial out-of-scope prompts to verify extractive citations and refusal accuracy.
Gate 2 — ACL & DLP Verification: Confirm SharePoint security group access, WebSearch state, and Power Platform DLP compliance.
Gate 3 — Pilot & Admin Catalog Publish: Deploy to a pilot Entra group first, inspect Activity traces, then publish via M365 Admin Center.
Gate 4 — Continuous Telemetry & Lifecycle: Monitor unanswered query rates in Copilot Studio Analytics and review orphaned owners quarterly.

rows: 100% pass on extractive citations & refusal tests

Pilot telemetry clean; published to target Entra group
